cue: Wave one hand side to side (Hello / Hi)
description: The robot raises its arm to a high, visible position with the gripper pointing upward and performs a friendly side-to-side waving motion using the wrist.

cue: Raise one hand briefly (Greeting / Acknowledgement)
description: The robot quickly raises its arm to a high, visible position with the gripper pointing upward in a palm-forward orientation. It performs a sharp upward lift followed by a small wrist tilt to signal a brief acknowledgment or greeting.

cue: Bow slightly from the waist (Respect / Greeting)
description: The robot arm moves to a high, centered position and then executes a smooth, deliberate arc forward and downward, holding the lowered posture to convey a respectful greeting.

cue: Extend one hand vertically forward as if offering a handshake (Asking for handshake)
description: The robot arm moves from a resting position, extending forward with a vertical gripper orientation to invite a handshake. It features a deliberate reaching motion and a final hold to allow for human interaction.

cue: Move one hand up and down vertically as if shaking someone’s hand (Imitating handshake)
description: The robot extends its arm forward with the gripper in a vertical orientation to mimic a handshake, then performs a series of firm up-and-down oscillations at the elbow.

cue: Wrap both arms around yourself (Hug / Comfort)
description: The robot moves its arm across its chest, curling inward with the gripper facing its own body to simulate a self-embrace, followed by a rhythmic squeezing motion and a gentle circular rub for comfort.

cue: Bring fingertips to lips and blow outward (Blow a kiss)
description: The robot brings its gripper close to its 'mouth' area in a horizontal orientation, pauses briefly to simulate a kiss, then performs a quick flicking motion and an outward arc to represent blowing the kiss toward someone.

cue: Form a big heart shape above head (Love)
description: The robot reaches high above its head to trace a large, expressive heart shape in the air. It starts at the top center cleft, sweeps a curved path downward for the right lobe, anchors a sharp bottom point, and then completes the left lobe with a symmetrical upward arc, holding the final posture to emphasize the sentiment.

cue: Place one hand over chest (Sincerity / Gratitude)
description: The robot moves its hand in a slow, graceful motion towards the center of its torso. The gripper points inward toward the body to simulate a hand-on-heart gesture, conveying sincerity, deep gratitude, or an 'of course' sentiment.

cue: Raise both fists upward (Victory / Excitement)
description: The robot quickly raises its arm from a mid-low position to a high, triumphant extension, performing several rapid 'pumping' motions at the peak to signify celebration.

cue: Pump one fist downward (Success / Yes!)
description: The robot raises its arm to a high starting position and then executes a sharp, forceful downward stroke accompanied by a final wrist snap to signify triumph or emphatic agreement.

cue: Flex one arm to show bicep (Strength)
description: The robot arm moves into a classic bodybuilding pose by raising the upper arm and snapping the elbow inward to simulate a bicep flex, holding the position with high tension to show strength.

cue: Nod head up and down (Yes)
description: The robot mimics a nodding gesture by tilting the end-effector (representing a head) down and up repeatedly to signal affirmation or agreement.

cue: Shake head side to side (No)
description: The robot arm mimics a head-shaking 'no' gesture by positioning the gripper upright to act as a head and then performing a quick, repetitive side-to-side rotation.

cue: Shrug shoulders with palms up (I don’t know)
description: The robot quickly lifts its arm and rotates the gripper to a horizontal, palms-up position while slightly spreading the arm outward to signal uncertainty.

cue: Scratch head lightly (Confusion)
description: The robot raises its hand to the side of its upper assembly and performs a rapid, light scratching motion with the wrist, followed by a slight shift and a final thoughtful pause to convey uncertainty or confusion.

cue: Tilt head slightly (Curiosity)
description: The robot mimics an inquisitive human gesture by positioning the gripper to face forward as a 'head' and then slowly tilting it to one side, holding the position to signal interest or confusion.

cue: Place palm over face (Facepalm / Frustration)
description: The robot quickly brings its gripper toward its face area with the tip pointing inward, holds the position in a classic facepalm gesture, and then slowly drags the hand downward to signal deep frustration.

cue: Point to chest with index finger (Me)
description: The robot identifies itself by orienting the gripper toward its own chest and moving the arm inward to perform a clear, emphatic double tap on its torso area.

cue: Point forward with index finger (You)
description: The robot arm extends sharply forward, orienting the gripper vertically to simulate a pointing finger. A small wrist flick at the end emphasizes the target of the gesture.

cue: Turn palm downward and curl fingers inward repeatedly (Come here / Beckon)
description: The robot extends its arm forward with the gripper oriented horizontally to simulate a downward-facing palm. It then performs a series of rapid wrist and elbow flexions to beckon a person to come closer.

cue: Extend palm forward flat (Stop)
description: The robot quickly raises its arm and extends it forward with the gripper pointing upward and the palm facing outward, creating an emphatic and clear 'stop' or 'halt' signal.

cue: Raise index finger upright (One moment / Important point)
description: The robot arm moves into a ready position and then sharply raises the gripper upwards. A quick, emphatic wrist flick punctuates the motion to signal an important point or to request a brief pause, ending in a steady, high-visibility hold.

cue: Place index finger on lips (Shh / Be quiet)
description: The robot prepares its hand in a vertical orientation and brings it close to its facial area, mimicking the human 'shh' gesture to signal for silence.

cue: Pat stomach lightly (Hungry / Full)
description: The robot positions its gripper horizontally near its midsection, pointing toward its own body, and performs a series of rhythmic patting motions to signal hunger or satiety.

cue: Rub both upper arms (Cold)
description: The robot arm crosses the torso to reach the opposite shoulder area, then performs rapid, short-stroke rubbing motions to simulate shivering and the act of warming oneself up.

cue: Fan face with one hand (Hot)
description: The robot raises its hand to the side of its head and performs a rapid, repetitive fanning motion with the wrist to indicate it is overheated.

cue: Open mouth wide and cover it (Sleepy / Yawn)
description: The robot arm simulates a weary yawn by slowly tilting back to represent an open-mouthed stretch, then quickly brings the gripper to a horizontal position directly in front of its 'face' to cover the yawn.

cue: Rub one eye (Tired)
description: The robot moves its gripper to face level, pointing it inward toward the eye, and performs a repetitive horizontal rubbing motion to signify tiredness, ending with a slow, weary hold as the arm begins to sag.

cue: Bow deeply while hands at sides (Apology)
description: The robot performs a sincere, formal bow by lowering its entire arm assembly while keeping the gripper pointed straight down, simulating hands held at the sides during a deep Japanese-style apology.

cue: Raise both hands and flex index and middle fingers twice (Air quotes)
description: The robot arm raises to a high position at head level with the gripper pointing upward. It then performs two sharp, rhythmic downward-and-upward wrist tilts to mimic the 'air quotes' gesture.

cue: Tap temple with index finger (Think / Smart)
description: The robot raises its arm to the side of its head, pointing the gripper toward its temple, and performs a series of quick, sharp taps to indicate intelligence, a good idea, or 'think about it'.

cue: Rotate index finger near temple (Crazy)
description: The robot arm lifts the gripper to the side of the head and traces small, rapid circles with the wrist to indicate the 'crazy' gesture.

cue: Slide index finger across lips like zipping (Secret / Won’t tell)
description: The robot mimics zipping its lips to signify a secret. It brings the gripper to the right side of its mouth area, held vertically, then slides it quickly across to the left, holding the final position for emphasis.

cue: Cross arms over chest (Defensive)
description: The robot quickly sweeps its arm across its torso and pulls it tight against the chest, holding a closed and defensive posture.

cue: Place both hands on hips (Confidence / Annoyed)
description: The robot arm moves decisively toward the hip, rotating the gripper to face the body in a firm stance. The motion conveys a sense of authority or impatience through its rapid placement and static hold.

cue: Lean forward slightly with palms open (Interest)
description: The robot demonstrates active listening and curiosity by extending its arm forward and slightly downward while keeping the gripper in a horizontal, open-palm orientation.

cue: Step back slightly with both palms raised outward (Shock / Surprise)
description: A sudden defensive reaction where the arm recoils sharply toward the body while the hand is raised with the palm facing forward, followed by a rapid shudder to convey a startle response.

cue: Cover mouth with palm (Gasp / Oops)
description: The robot quickly brings its gripper to its upper body area, pointing the tip toward itself to mimic a hand covering a mouth in surprise, shock, or after a mistake.

cue: Press palms together and bow slightly (Thank you / Respect)
description: The robot brings its gripper to a centered position at chest height, pointing upward to mimic a prayer-like gesture, then executes a slow, deliberate forward tilt of the arm to signal gratitude and respect.

cue: Raise one hand as if holding an invisible glass (Cheers)
description: The robot mimics a celebratory toast by raising its arm to chest height, lifting it slightly as if saluting, and performing a subtle wrist tilt forward before holding the position.

cue: Raise one palm upward as if inviting a high five (Asking for high five)
description: The robot arm raises its hand to a high, forward position with the gripper pointing up and the palm facing forward. It then performs a slight forward nudge to clearly signal an invitation for a high-five.

cue: Swing one raised palm downward as if high-fiving air (Imitating high five)
description: The robot arm reaches upward and forward to a high 'ready' position with the palm facing forward, pauses for timing, and then executes a rapid downward strike to simulate a high-five impact.

cue: Extend one fist forward (Asking for fist bump)
description: The robot positions its gripper vertically to simulate a closed fist, then thrusts the arm forward in a decisive but friendly motion, holding the position to wait for a person to complete the bump.

cue: Tap one fist lightly against your other palm (Imitating fist bump)
description: The robot positions its gripper in a vertical orientation in front of its midline and performs two short, sharp downward tapping motions to mimic the gesture of striking a fist against a palm for emphasis or agreement.

cue: Pat your own back (Encouragement)
description: The robot reaches its arm up and over its shoulder, positioning the gripper to face its own back, and performs a series of gentle tapping motions to simulate self-congratulation or a 'well done' gesture.

cue: Draw a circle in the air with index finger (Repeat / Around)
description: The robot extends its arm to a forward-pointing position and traces three continuous circles in a vertical plane in front of it, signifying 'around', 'repeat', or 'cycle'.

cue: Slice flat hand horizontally across throat (Cut / Stop it)
description: The robot raises its hand to the side of its neck with the gripper held horizontally, then executes a sharp, rapid lateral swipe across the throat area, holding the final position briefly to signal an immediate stop or end.

cue: Swipe back of fingers outward from under chin (Dismissive / Whatever)
description: The robot arm positions the gripper under its chin with the tip pointing toward its neck, then executes a sharp, fast upward and outward arc to mimic the 'chin flick' gesture used to signal indifference or dismissal.

cue: Drum fingers on table or in air (Waiting / Bored)
description: The robot positions its gripper facing downward at table height and performs two sequences of rapid, rhythmic wrist taps to simulate impatient finger drumming, shifting slightly between them to show restlessness.

cue: Turn palm upward and curl fingers inward (Give me)
description: The robot extends its arm forward with the palm facing upward and performs a repetitive beckoning motion by curling the wrist toward itself, signaling a request for an item.

cue: Extend open palm upward steadily (Offering)
description: The robot arm moves from a neutral, retracted position to a forward-extended and elevated posture with the palm facing upward (horizontal), simulating a deliberate and inviting offering or presentation gesture.

cue: Raise both hands beside head (I give up / Surrender)
description: The robot quickly jerks its arm upward to a high, retracted position beside the head with the gripper pointing straight up and the 'palms' facing forward, signaling submission or surrender.

cue: Cover both ears (Too loud / Don’t want to hear)
description: The robot raises its arm to the side of its head with the gripper oriented vertically, pressing inward and trembling slightly to mimic blocking out an overwhelming or unwelcome sound.

cue: Open both arms wide outward (Welcome)
description: The robot initiates a welcoming gesture by moving its arm from a central position in a broad, expansive arc outward to the side, finishing in an open posture that signals invitation.

cue: Stretch both arms upward (Relief / Stretch)
description: The robot arm reaches high toward its maximum vertical extension with a slow, deliberate motion, followed by a subtle wrist oscillation to simulate the tension release of a deep stretch, concluding in a peak upward hold.

cue: Bring one hand to forehead in salute position (Salute)
description: The robot quickly raises its arm to its temple with a sharp, disciplined motion, holding the position to signal respect or readiness.

cue: Place one hand above eyebrows as visor and look far (Searching distance)
description: The robot arm lifts the gripper to head height and orients it horizontally across its 'brow' to mimic a visor. It then performs a slow, deliberate side-to-side scan to simulate looking for something in the distance.
